labels: P - Hover or focus content persistent
spec_items.body: During the categorization exercise today, members had difficulty understanding why Hover content persistent had been broken apart from Hover or focus content persistent. I suggest considering whether hover content persistent can be removed and Hover of focus content persistent can be moved into core requirements.

spec_items.body: Provision text: > Error messages are visually collocated with the error source or the focus is moved to the error message and a mechanism is available to move to the input that is in error.
